description: One BucketLog scanning session, grouping the Bucket Log Entry captures it produced. Kept separate from the entries themselves (rather than computed on the fly every time) because a foreman or a payroll run wants 'how did this session go' as one row, not an aggregation query — total_accepted/total_rejected are filled in by sync_bucket_entries as entries arrive, from bucket_bridge.aggregate_session.

fields.description: The series a Bucket Log Session is named from, expanded by the controller (year is the session's own started_at year) so a docname is the same shape on a bench and in the standalone suite — BLS-2026-0001.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The iOS session's own UUID — the key Bucket Log Entry.session_uuid joins back to.
fields.label: Session UUID

fields.description: Which company this session's picking belongs to.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Open is still receiving entries. Closed means the device ended the session. Linked means every entry in it has been attributed to a shift.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The QR badge ID scanned for this session.
fields.label: Worker Badge

fields.description: Who worked this session, resolved from worker_badge the same way a Bucket Log Entry's own employee is.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: The device this session ran on.
fields.label: Device ID

fields.description: When the session closed, or the latest entry's timestamp for a session still Open.
fields.label: Ended At

fields.description: Computed by sync_bucket_entries from this session's own entries — bucket_bridge.aggregate_session, not a running counter a client increments.
fields.label: Total Accepted

fields.description: Computed the same way as total_accepted.
fields.label: Total Rejected

name: Bucket Log Session
